blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Point Grey is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 101 homes sold there: 67 houses, 21 condos, 7 townhomes and 6 duplexes. 67 houses sold in Point Grey with a median price of $3,050,000 (the middle half sold between $2,552,500 and $4,227,619), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 93.8% of the last list price; 4% sold above list.
Point Grey home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

67 houses sold in Point Grey with a median price of $3,050,000 (the middle half sold between $2,552,500 and $4,227,619), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 93.8% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $1,095 per square foot, a median year built of 1984 and a median lot of 4,093 square feet. 21 condos sold in Point Grey with a median price of $875,000 (the middle half sold between $608,000 and $1,050,000), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $891 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $541 a month.

faq.q: What did homes in Point Grey sell for?
faq.a: 67 houses sold in Point Grey between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $3,050,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Point Grey?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 93.8% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Point Grey sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 67 houses that sold in Point Grey went for between $2,552,500 and $4,227,619, around a median of $3,050,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Point Grey sell above asking price?
faq.a: 4% of the 67 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 93.8% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Point Grey?
faq.a: The median year built was 1984 for the 67 houses sold in Point Grey.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Point Grey usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Point Grey had 5 bedrooms, from the 67 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Vancouver?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
